sections.heading: What is trending: “cyber attack”
paragraphs: “cyber attack” appeared on Google Trends' Trending Now list for CA (snapshot taken 2026-11-13T22:37:00+00:00 UTC). Google reports at least 200 searches for this term — that figure is a lower bound published in the official Trends feed, not an exact count.

sections.heading: What's behind the spike — the coverage
paragraphs: The Trends feed associates this search spike with 3 news stories from GitGuardian Blog, Microsoft, Salesforce. The headlines, exactly as published:
list: “Threat actors use agentic AI tooling to find and abuse exposed secrets” — Microsoft
“Beyond ARTEX: 45 Agentic Attack Frameworks, What They Hunt For, and How to Find Them” — GitGuardian Blog

sections.heading: Timeline
paragraphs: The trend entry was published to the Google Trends feed at Fri, 13 Nov 2026 14:10:00 -0800. Our snapshot was taken at 2026-11-13T22:37:00+00:00 UTC and this briefing was assembled at 2026-11-13T22:38:20+00:00 UTC.

sections.heading: How to read these numbers
paragraphs: Google Trends reports approximate search volume as a lower bound (for example “20K+”). Actual volume can be significantly higher. Trending status reflects acceleration in searches, not the absolute size of a topic. For the full story behind the spike, read the cited coverage below — this briefing intentionally adds no speculation beyond the sourced facts.

faq.q: How many people searched for “cyber attack”?
faq.a: Google reports at least 200 searches in CA as of the feed snapshot. This is a published lower bound, not an exact count.
This snapshot covers CA. The same term may trend differently in other regions.
